implemented: RequestScope owns a lazy reference attachment distinct from an enclosing application, destroys tracked source handles before closing the heap on the owner thread, and preserves independent immutable snapshots.

Application and request attachments share an inactive/creating/active/closed factory state machine, retry failed creation, reject reentry/mismatched factories/reinitialization, and retire candidates if their owner ends during construction.

Private checked no-argument unit/i64 request entry emits nex_private_reference_request(Handle **), clears the caller-owned source-error slot, checks live request ownership, and preserves full-width scalar status without an application/process wrapper.
Native cell operations poll before and after work; cross-thread cancellation only marks/revokes, and source/heap destruction occurs during owner-thread unwind. Completed writes are not rolled back.
CMake installation includes the new request fixtures and the existing imported host_fixture.py helper; moved installed runtime sources rebuild request consumers and the ordinary public CLI project.
